notes: All samples are ribosome profiling (28-42 nt monosome-protected fragments) -> assay_class ribosome_footprints; flag for exclusion. Temperature shift 32 -> 42 C at time 0 for lambda cI857 lysogen and non-lysogen MG1655; lysogen post-shift = heat + prophage induction (treatment phage;heat). Lysogen genotype_class, inducer_added and mixed_organism (phage transcripts) left out. Chloramphenicol 2 min before harvest is part of the footprinting protocol, not a treatment. Medium not stated; OD 0.4-0.5 fits mid_exponential in either medium type, kept for all samples (<= 20 min after shift).

growth_phase.q: incubated with shaking at 32°C to an optical density at 600 nm (OD600) of 0.4 to 0.5

transcription_arrested.q: sampling the lysogen and control non-lysogen both before and 2, 5, 10, and 20 minutes after shifting the temperature from 32° to 42°

is_control.q: sampling the lysogen and control non-lysogen both before and 2, 5, 10, and 20 minutes after shifting the temperature from 32° to 42°

treatment.q: sampling the lysogen and control non-lysogen both before and 2, 5, 10, and 20 minutes after shifting

growth_temperature.q: Cultures were transferred to a 42 °C water bath

treatment.q: temperature induction of the classic cI857 repressor mutation in a lysogen of E. coli MG1655
